label: Vue 3 + Vue Router + Pinia
router: vue-router createRouter({ history: createWebHistory() }), RouterView + RouterLink, useRoute/useRouter
state: Pinia setup store: ref() for products, filters, page and a reactive Set of favourites; computed() for the filtered list, page rows, page count and summary. Filter inputs bind with v-model through writable computeds.
notes: products is a plain ref() of the 5,000 records (deeply reactive, proxied lazily on access), as the docs write a store; shallowRef would be a size-specific optimisation the contract excludes.
